keyChoice.rule: reject a key when more than 0.5% of subject pixels have key dominance >= 40; first acceptable candidate wins

timeline.text: hold exactly the supplied reference pose, nothing moves yet
a steady walk in place, one full left-right pair of steps about every 0.8 seconds
finish the current step and bring the feet back into the starting stance
hold exactly the starting pose, position and scale

give the numeric work region, e.g. 'inside the work region x=316..965, y=20..646 of this 1280x720 image'
give a timeline in seconds, e.g. '0.0-0.4 s hold the reference pose; ...'
